fixtures.name: simple-turn
fixtures.quirk: one turn: `session_meta`, `turn_context`, `task_started`, a null `token_count`, a populated one, `task_complete`

fixtures.name: multi-turn
fixtures.quirk: two turns in one rollout, each with its own cumulative `total_token_usage`

fixtures.name: with-tool-call
fixtures.quirk: function calls and their outputs as `response_item` records

fixtures.name: with-spawn-agent
fixtures.quirk: a `spawn_agent` function call: delegation stated in the tool call, not in session metadata

fixtures.name: compaction
fixtures.quirk: a `compacted` record with `replacement_history`, followed by `context_compacted` and a fresh turn

fixtures.name: compaction-usage-only
fixtures.quirk: burn's `compaction.jsonl` with its session id renamed so it does not collide with this corpus's `compaction.jsonl`, which adds message records: two turns either side of a `compacted` record whose only usage evidence is their cumulative `token_count`s, with no assistant message

fixtures.name: session-meta-relationships
fixtures.quirk: `sourceSessionId` / `forkSessionId` / `continuedFromSessionId` on a repeated `session_meta`

fixtures.name: user-turn-blocks
fixtures.quirk: user input arriving as `response_item` message blocks rather than `event_msg`

fixtures.name: oversized-shell-output
fixtures.quirk: an 80 KB shell function-call output

fixtures.name: parent-thread-id
fixtures.quirk: a subagent rollout naming its root through `parent_thread_id` plus `thread_source: subagent`

fixtures.name: archived-session
fixtures.quirk: a rollout under `~/.codex/archived_sessions/`, the second codex discovery root

fixtures.name: counter-regressed
fixtures.quirk: a cached-input counter grows faster than total input, making the cumulative delta unnormalizable

fixtures.name: counter-negative
fixtures.quirk: a cumulative snapshot contains a negative input counter that must be preserved and refused

fixtures.name: counter-fractional
fixtures.quirk: a cumulative snapshot contains a fractional output counter that must be preserved and refused

fixtures.name: counter-above-i64
fixtures.quirk: a valid cumulative counter exceeds `i64::MAX` and must survive parsing as a `u64`

fixtures.name: counter-recovers
fixtures.quirk: an unreadable cumulative snapshot is superseded by a later valid snapshot for the same waiting turn

fixtures.name: counter-unusable-then-new-turn
fixtures.quirk: a later advancing delta covers an earlier unreadable snapshot and clears only refusals in that span

fixtures.name: reasoning-then-unreadable
fixtures.quirk: a reasoning row waits through an unreadable snapshot before a valid delta measures the turn

fixtures.name: refusal-across-baseline-reinstall
fixtures.quirk: a refusal predating a cumulative-baseline reinstall must not be cleared by a later delta

fixtures.name: refusal-overwritten-after-reinstall
fixtures.quirk: two refusals for one turn straddle a baseline reinstall and remain tied to their own generations

fixtures.name: resume-baseline-corrupt
fixtures.quirk: a resumed rollout starts with an unreadable baseline, so carried-over totals cannot become one request's delta

fixtures.name: two-unreadable-turns
fixtures.quirk: two unrecovered turns each retain their own unreadable usage refusal

fixtures.name: one-request-three-rows
fixtures.quirk: one API call written as reasoning, a tool call and a message is one request, not three

fixtures.name: recovered-span-covers-two-turns
fixtures.quirk: a readable snapshot recovers a span an unreadable one left open, so its delta measures both turns as one request

fixtures.name: context-wrapper
fixtures.quirk: an `<environment_context>` wrapper the app injects as a user `response_item` ahead of the human's mirrored turn

fixtures.name: two-requests-one-turn
fixtures.quirk: a tool loop makes two API calls inside one turn_id, so the turn is not the request

fixtures.name: fork-human
fixtures.quirk: a human fork (`forked_from_id`, `thread_source: user`) whose rollout replays the parent's `session_meta`, both turns and their cumulative `token_count` before its own turn

fixtures.name: fork-paginated
fixtures.quirk: a Codex 0.144 human fork (`history_mode: paginated`) whose rollout copies both parent turns and their cumulative `token_count` straight after its own `session_meta`, without the parent's

fixtures.name: fork-subagent
fixtures.quirk: a spawned subagent naming its parent in `source.subagent.thread_spawn.parent_thread_id`, replaying the parent's open turn (with a tool call) and starting its own turn in the thread id's own millisecond

fixtures.name: guardian-review
fixtures.quirk: a Codex 0.150+ `thread_source: guardian_review` rollout with `parent_thread_id` that opens on a `compaction` item rather than a replay
